basic_info.description: Imagine waking up on a tree-lined street, just a block from Marina Green. At 3747 Scott St., this dream is your reality. This stunning 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo blends quintessential San Francisco charm with high-end updates. The large living room, drenched in morning sunshine, leads to the dining room, perfect for entertaining. The chef's kitchen features custom solid walnut cabinetry, Italian quartz countertops, and a full backsplash with Walker Zanger quartz tiles. Thermador appliances, including a 6-burner range, rotisserie oven, and wine fridge, complete this culinary haven. The spa-like full bath boasts heated floors, a soaking tub with a frameless glass panel, and elegant Anne Sacks tile. A generous half bath adds convenience. Hardwood floors and recessed lighting enhance the home's beauty. The two spacious bedrooms open to a private south-facing deck overlooking an exclusive-use backyardyour rare oasis in the Marina. With two dedicated parking spaces in a finished garage, convenience is unmatched. Steps from Marina Green, Crissy Field, Chestnut Street, and more. Don't miss this very special home!
